principle: A system must not be able to loosen its own guardrails. NEO may never change these paths by itself: a change needs a commit authored by a human, or an explicit human approval of the exact diff plus an independent security review.
matching: Globs of neo-verify (the diff check of a verification contract): `*` and `?` stay inside one path segment, `**` as a whole segment matches any number of segments including none, matching is case-sensitive, there are no classes, braces or escapes. check-protected.sh additionally folds case and refuses unusual paths and symlinks.
